answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital lockup. An attacker cannot simply wander into the network to spin up illicit nodes; they must acquire significant assets, a process akin to tracking a rare opal in a vast field. This economic barrier ensures that every malicious attempt incurs a comet of financial losses, as the protocol slashes staked collateral for any detectable Byzantine behavior, effectively forcing a high entry cost.
